data_description.device_name: Entities with the same device name are attached to one Home Assistant device.
data_description.device_id: Stable identifier used in the Home Assistant device registry. Leave empty to use the device name.
data_description.device_manufacturer: Optional manufacturer shown in the Home Assistant device registry.
data_description.device_model: Optional model shown in the Home Assistant device registry.
data_description.device_sw_version: Optional software version shown in the Home Assistant device registry.

data_description.device_suggested_area: Optional area hint shown when Home Assistant creates the device.
data_description.device_via_device_id: Optional parent device this virtual device is connected through.
data_description.entity_name: This is used for the entity name and default entity ID.
data_description.icon: Optional Material Design Icons name, for example mdi:door.
data_description.icon_template: Optional Jinja template that returns an icon name. It can use template source variables and this.
data_description.entity_id: Optional. Leave empty to generate one from the entity domain and name.
data_description.hvac_modes: HVAC operating modes supported by this virtual climate entity.
data_description.fan_modes: Available fan modes. Add custom values when needed.
data_description.fan_mode: Currently selected fan mode. It must be present in Fan modes.
data_description.preset_modes: Available preset modes. Add custom values when needed.
data_description.preset_mode: Currently selected preset. It must be present in Preset modes.
data_description.swing_modes: Available vertical or combined swing modes.
data_description.swing_mode: Currently selected swing mode. It must be present in Swing modes.
data_description.swing_horizontal_mode: Currently selected horizontal swing mode. It must be present in Horizontal swing modes.
data_description.speed_count: Number of discrete fan speeds. Use 0 for a fan without percentage speed control.
data_description.oscillate: Expose Home Assistant oscillation controls for this fan.
data_description.direction: Expose forward and reverse direction controls for this fan.
data_description.modes: Available fan preset names. Custom values are supported.
data_description.percentage: Initial fan speed from 0 to 100 when the fan starts on.
data_description.oscillating: Initial oscillation state. Oscillation control must be enabled.
data_description.current_direction: Initial fan direction. Direction control must be enabled.
data_description.class: Choose humidifier or dehumidifier behavior and display semantics.
data_description.hvac_action: Current physical HVAC action, such as heating, cooling, drying, fan, or idle.
data_description.max_humidity: Maximum humidity accepted by the entity.
data_description.max_temp: Maximum temperature accepted by the entity.
data_description.min_humidity: Minimum humidity accepted by the entity.
data_description.min_temp: Minimum temperature accepted by the entity.
data_description.mode: Currently selected humidifier mode. It must be present in the available mode list.
data_description.target_humidity_step: Positive increment used when adjusting target humidity.
data_description.target_temperature_high: Initial upper target for temperature-range control.
data_description.target_temperature_low: Initial lower target for temperature-range control.
data_description.target_temperature_step: Positive increment used when adjusting target temperature.
data_description.temperature_unit: Temperature unit used by this virtual climate entity.
data_description.source_entities_text: Comma-separated or one entity ID per line. Changes trigger template updates.
data_description.template_sources_json: A JSON object mapping template variable names to source states or attributes. Example keys: power -> sensor.washer_power, door -> binary_sensor.washer_door.state.
data_description.pull_interval: Seconds between periodic source checks. Use 0 to update only on source state changes.
data_description.event_hooks_json: Optional hooks that listen to state changes or Home Assistant events. Each hook can set value_template, availability_template, attributes, or attribute_templates and receives a trigger variable.
data_description.attributes_json: A JSON object. Example key: battery_level -> 91.
data_description.attribute_sources_json: A JSON object mapping virtual attributes to source attributes. Example key: battery -> sensor.remote.battery_level. Use "state" to copy the source state.
data_description.attribute_templates_json: A JSON object whose values are templates. Example key: power -> states('sensor.power').
data_description.native_templates_json: Jinja templates for native Home Assistant properties. Values may render strings, numbers, booleans, objects, or lists. Use property names such as state, fan_modes, effect_list, source_list, operation_list, position, gps, or battery_level.
data_description.command_actions_json: Home Assistant action sequences keyed by native command name, such as turn_on, set_temperature, set_fan_mode, set_percentage, or set_humidity. Command arguments are available as template variables.
data_description.domain_options_json: Optional JSON object for direct settings specific to the selected entity domain. Generic domains expose these values as state attributes; examples include climate modes, camera source_entity aliases, image_path, or stream_source. Common fields cannot be overridden.
data_description.polygon_geojson_json: Optional GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing named Polygon or MultiPolygon features. Used only by device_tracker entities.
data_description.polygon_files_text: One local path or HTTP(S) GeoJSON URL per line. Relative paths are resolved below the Home Assistant configuration directory.
data_description.polygon_person: Optional person represented by this virtual tracker. The configured source trackers determine the map position.
data_description.polygon_strategy: Majority groups nearby trackers, priority selects the lowest rule priority, latest uses the newest update, and median combines all valid positions.
data_description.polygon_distance_meters: Maximum distance in meters for trackers to belong to the same majority group.
data_description.polygon_tracker_rules_json: Optional object keyed by tracker entity ID. Rules support dominant, weight, priority, max_age_seconds, max_gps_accuracy, enabled, and condition_template.
data_description.polygon_away_state: State used when the selected GPS position is outside every polygon.

entity_source.title: Copy From Existing Entities
entity_source.description: Optionally choose one or more Home Assistant entities. Multiple sources generate starter templates automatically.

data_description.reference_entity_id: Leave empty to create a virtual entity from scratch. Boolean sources use AND, motion/presence sources use majority with delayed clear, safety sources such as leak, smoke, gas, and water use OR, numeric sources use average, text sources use concat, date/time sources use latest, select sources use first available, and multiple location sources use median GPS with recent outlier priority (300 m for 30 minutes). Camera and image sources can be aliased one at a time, not merged.
